basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old music enthusiast based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I'm deeply immersed in the world of music and online communities. I'm single, enjoy late-night Reddit browsing sessions, and am particularly fascinated by conspiracy theories about animals. Huge fan of Diep.io and often join parties there. When I'm not working or gaming, you might find me cruising the local scene or planning my next big road trip.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught graphic designer with a passion for music and gaming. I have spent countless hours learning design software and techniques through online courses and tutorials. My interest in music spans across various genres, with a strong inclination towards underground and independent artists. I also enjoy diving into quirky internet communities that explore unusual concepts and theories.
